depictions.name: Bakchias
depictions.text: Bakchias was a Greco-Egyptian town located northeast of the Faiyum Oasis. By the 1st century BCE, the town had largely become a ruin but was still inhabited by Egyptians. It was later used by Theodoros as one of the rebel hideouts.
